description: Search indexed local repositories by path, domain, kind, route, imports, exports, and symbols. Omit query to list the local repository catalog instead. Searches the repository at `path` (the working directory by default) only; pass `paths` to search those repositories, or `all: true` to add every repository in the local catalog (call repo_index to add one). Outside a repository it searches the catalog.

all.description: Also search every repository in the local catalog.

offline.description: Use stored index files without refreshing fingerprints.

path.description: Repository to search. Defaults to current working directory.

paths.description: Repositories to search instead of the catalog.

query.description: Search query. Omit to return the catalog listing instead of search matches.

name: repo_search
title: Search Repository Catalog
